LESSON: KUSOMA 12.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFASAHA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAGONJWA AMBUKIZI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujif
Topic 12.2: Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
2. kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
3. kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha.
4. Show that you can: kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 12.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
2. kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
3. kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
